classes.name: manifest
classes.reason: Each round's class_a read is sandwiched between barrier.wait() calls so every rank waits at the second barrier until the slowest rank's read of that round's file completes, and since the path embeds the round index r, a given file is read only once.

classes.name: sidecar
classes.reason: The per-rank _read() loop over class_cs_per_rank happens after the barrier with no synchronization wrapping each individual read, so only the issuing rank blocks on os.pread while others proceed independently, and because the path doesn't depend on round r, the same file is re-read once per round for all 200 rounds.

classes.name: shard
classes.reason: Like class_c, the class_b reads via _read() occur outside any immediate barrier so each rank blocks only itself on the synchronous os.pread, and since the path is independent of the round index, the same file is accessed once per round across all 200 rounds.
